correctness.rationale: All cases specified: connected simple symmetric positive weighted finite graph, one absorbing vertex, one known seed, entire first-passage time, ordinary expected Fisher. Four-path exact conditional Bernoulli+geometric law gives smooth bijection from log-edge weights to (u,w) with 0<w<u<1; full Fisher diagonal [1/(u(1-u)),(1-u)/(w²(1-w))] with strictly positive determinant. Coordinates x=2arcsin(sqrt(u)), y=log((1-sqrt(1-w))/(1+sqrt(1-w))) give dx²+cos²(x/2)dy², curvature 1/4. Three-vertex path rank≤1; triangle exact parity+cycle product gives rank2 but flat. All finite smaller graphs covered, so sharp minimality proved. The actual check.py passed 3296 exact rational/symbolic assertions, supplementary to infinite analytic proofs. At a=b=1 log-edge Fisher is [[5/12,-1/6],[-1/6,1/6]] determinant 1/24.

value.rationale: Sharp smallest-graph classification distinguishes rank from curvature: 3-node triangle has rank-two but flat complete-hitting-time Fisher, whereas 4-node reversible path has rank-two strictly positive curvature 1/4. It resolves a concrete identifiability/curvature issue arising in 2026 graph-based inference, supplies exact finite-sample KL and parameter identifiability, and demonstrates why flat-quotient methods cannot universally describe the complete hitting-time statistic. The graph bound and geometric contrast provide structural mathematical motivation beyond a trivial formula correction.
